status_note: PENDING ACTIVATION. Record ids (c_ + sha256[:10] of the canonical change JSON) and manifestHash are sha256 values over canonical JSON produced by repository code (src/core/defectcorpus/hashes.ts canonicalJson + changeContentSha256). Computing them exactly needs that code to run, which Dirty Mode forbids, so no hash is written and no record is listed. Generation is DEFERRED-VALIDATION DV-26. Nothing here is guessed.

generation_rule: For every task directory under corpus/dev and every variant in its variants/ folder, build the record with src/core/defectcorpus/projection.ts toPublicRecord(variant, task, { manifestHash, embargoStatus: 'open' }); files are the touched files only.
Sort records by id (code-unit order). The order must not reveal which change is the correct, near-miss or seeded head.
manifestHash = sha256 of canonicalJson(records sorted by id, each without its manifestHash field); then set it on every record.
Validate every record with PublicManifestRecordSchema and assert ids are unique (ids.ts assertUniqueNeutralIds).
